policy: Reviewed Gitleaks exceptions are exact report fingerprints, frozen by per-rule sorted-fingerprint SHA-256 plus exact counts. Any added, removed, moved, changed, unexpected-rule, stale, or expired finding fails P10-X.

suppressions.justification: Reviewed historical findings are confined to synthetic CI/test fixture identifiers and explicitly synthetic provider/AWS credential placeholders; none grants live provider, production, or customer access. The added exact fingerprint is the unchanged p10s-synthetic AWS placeholder re-emitted when the P10-S docker-run line was edited to enforce the frozen CPU envelope. The exact fingerprint-set digest prevents this review from covering any other changed or newly introduced finding.

Reviewed findings are duplicate detections for two historical local-development response capture files from 2026-05-09. Those bearer tokens are historical/expired and are not production credentials. The exact fingerprint-set digest prevents suppression of any new JWT finding.
